catalogSource: EVE Static Map Planner 1.2.0 eve-static-map MCP catalog audited 2026-09-03

tools.name: search_system
tools.purpose: Search systems and resolve canonical IDs from names, abbreviations, or numeric text.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: systems[] candidates with canonical identity and safe summary fields.
tools.whenToUse: Once for each distinct unresolved user-supplied system reference.
commonSequence: optional follow-up read or write tool

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.purpose: Read static details for one canonical system.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: system, region, constellation, stargate count, and 3D coordinates.
tools.whenToUse: When details beyond lookup results are requested.
preconditions: Canonical systemId resolved by MCP in the conversation.

tools.name: get_system_markers
tools.purpose: Read the Saved Marker and current Mission Markers for a system.
tools.sideEffects: None; Saved Marker read is permission-gated.
tools.expectedResult: savedMarker and missionMarkers for the system.
tools.whenToUse: When the user asks whether or how a system is marked.
preconditions: Saved Marker Access enabled to read savedMarker.

tools.name: list_wormholes
tools.purpose: List all temporary bidirectional Wormhole connections in the current application session.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: wormholes[] in deterministic canonical endpoint order.
tools.whenToUse: When the user asks about current Wormhole topology or connections for a resolved system.

tools.name: calculate_normal_route
tools.purpose: Atomically calculate one query-only normal route through ordered Waypoints with optional Ansiblex and Wormhole edges.
tools.inputSchema: startSystemId: number; waypointSystemIds?: number[]; destinationSystemId?: number; useAnsiblex: boolean; useWormholes?: boolean = false
tools.sideEffects: None; does not display a route.
tools.expectedResult: One complete route with systemIds, ordered waypointSystemIds, explicitDestinationSystemId, totalJumps, stargateJumps, ansiblexJumps, and wormholeJumps; no partial result on segment failure.
tools.whenToUse: For normal route answers that do not ask to change the map.
preconditions: Start and every explicit stop resolved to canonical system IDs.
At least one Waypoint or Destination.
No adjacent explicit stops are equal.
commonSequence: search every unresolved explicit stop once
one calculate_normal_route call containing the full ordered intent

tools.name: calculate_capital_route
tools.purpose: Atomically calculate one query-only capital route through ordered Waypoints for an effective range.
tools.inputSchema: startSystemId: number; waypointSystemIds?: number[]; destinationSystemId?: number; effectiveRangeLy: number
tools.sideEffects: None; does not display a route.
tools.expectedResult: One complete route with ordered waypointSystemIds, explicitDestinationSystemId, systemIds, legs, total jumps, and total distance in LY; no partial result on segment failure.
tools.whenToUse: For explicit capital or jump-route queries that do not ask for display.
preconditions: Start and every explicit stop resolved to canonical system IDs.
At least one Waypoint or Destination.
No adjacent explicit stops are equal.
commonSequence: search every unresolved explicit stop once
one calculate_capital_route call containing the full ordered intent

tools.name: list_views
tools.purpose: List all planning Views with stable IDs, editable labels, and current status.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: views[] with viewId, label, and current.
tools.whenToUse: Resolve a user-named View or inspect all Views.

tools.name: get_current_view
tools.purpose: Read the View currently displayed by the map.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: viewId, label, and current=true.
tools.whenToUse: When the current View identity is part of the answer.

tools.name: create_view
tools.purpose: Create and switch to a new planning View.
tools.sideEffects: Creates a View and makes it current.
tools.expectedResult: New viewId, unique label, and current=true.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to create a View.
preconditions: Requested label is unique when supplied.
commonSequence: list_views when label collision is possible

tools.name: rename_view
tools.purpose: Rename a planning View by stable ID.
tools.sideEffects: Changes the editable View label.
tools.expectedResult: viewId, new unique label, and current status.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to rename a View.

tools.name: switch_view
tools.purpose: Switch the map to a planning View by stable ID.
tools.sideEffects: Changes the currently displayed View and its visible planning state.
tools.expectedResult: Selected viewId, label, and current=true.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to display or switch to a View.

tools.name: delete_view
tools.purpose: Delete a planning View by stable ID.
tools.sideEffects: Deletes the View and its AI Missions; never logs out ESI characters.
tools.expectedResult: The current View after deletion.
tools.whenToUse: Only for an explicit request to delete a resolved View.
preconditions: At least one other View remains.

tools.name: get_active_missions
tools.purpose: List temporary AI Missions in the current session.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: missions[] summaries for the requested or current View.
tools.whenToUse: To inspect current AI-owned map state or resolve a Mission follow-up.

tools.name: get_mission
tools.purpose: Read one Mission and its routes, jump ranges, and markers.
tools.sideEffects: None.
tools.expectedResult: Mission title, revision, routes, jumpRanges, markers, and referenced systems.
tools.whenToUse: To answer Mission-state questions or obtain opaque IDs before narrow edits.
preconditions: Known missionId, normally from begin_mission or get_active_missions.

tools.name: list_eve_navigation_targets
tools.purpose: List safe EVE character identities and current availability for explicit Mission Normal navigation sending.
tools.sideEffects: None; does not send or change EVE navigation and never exposes OAuth credentials.
tools.expectedResult: targets[] with characterId, label, optional safe description, and available status.
tools.whenToUse: After an explicit user request to send one identified Mission Normal route to EVE and before selecting a character.
commonSequence: ask for an explicit character when missing or ambiguous

tools.name: begin_mission
tools.purpose: Create temporary AI-owned visual state.
tools.sideEffects: Creates a session-only AI Mission in the requested or current View.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, title, revision, and owning viewId.
tools.whenToUse: Before displaying a new route, jump range, or temporary marker that should persist on the map.
preconditions: Explicit user intent to change map state.
commonSequence: one or more Mission write tools

tools.name: focus_system
tools.purpose: Center the shared viewport on one system.
tools.sideEffects: Changes shared map viewport focus.
tools.expectedResult: Focused system identity and safe summary fields.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user explicitly asks to focus, center, locate, or show a system on the map.

tools.name: create_wormhole
tools.purpose: Create one temporary bidirectional Wormhole connection in global application-session topology.
tools.sideEffects: Adds one global session Wormhole; does not focus, switch Views, create a Mission, or persist across app exit.
tools.expectedResult: connection, created, and status; reverse duplicates return created=false and status=already_exists.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user explicitly asks to add a Wormhole between two resolved systems.

tools.name: show_normal_route
tools.purpose: Atomically calculate and display one Mission-owned normal route through ordered Waypoints with optional Ansiblex and current global Wormhole edges.
tools.inputSchema: missionId: string; startSystemId: number; waypointSystemIds?: number[]; destinationSystemId?: number; useAnsiblex: boolean; useWormholes?: boolean = false
tools.sideEffects: Adds exactly one complete normal route to a temporary Mission; adds nothing when any segment fails.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, routeId, type, and one complete route including ordered waypointSystemIds, explicitDestinationSystemId, and wormholeJumps.
tools.whenToUse: When the user explicitly asks to show or draw a normal route.
preconditions: Start and every explicit stop resolved.
At least one Waypoint or Destination.
No adjacent explicit stops are equal.
commonSequence: search every unresolved explicit stop once
one show_normal_route call containing the full ordered intent

tools.name: show_capital_route
tools.purpose: Atomically calculate and display one Mission-owned capital route through ordered Waypoints.
tools.inputSchema: missionId: string; startSystemId: number; waypointSystemIds?: number[]; destinationSystemId?: number; effectiveRangeLy: number
tools.sideEffects: Adds exactly one complete capital route to a temporary Mission; adds nothing when any segment fails.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, routeId, type, and one complete route including ordered waypointSystemIds and explicitDestinationSystemId.
tools.whenToUse: When the user explicitly asks to show an explicit-range capital route.
preconditions: Start and every explicit stop resolved.
At least one Waypoint or Destination.
No adjacent explicit stops are equal.
commonSequence: search every unresolved explicit stop once
one show_capital_route call containing the full ordered intent

tools.name: remove_mission_route
tools.purpose: Remove one Mission-owned route by opaque ID.
tools.sideEffects: Removes exactly one temporary Mission route.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: For an explicit request to remove one known Mission route.
preconditions: Target Mission inspected when routeId is not already known.

tools.name: clear_mission_routes
tools.purpose: Clear every route in one Mission.
tools.sideEffects: Removes all routes in the specified Mission only.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to clear all routes in one Mission.

tools.name: show_jump_range
tools.purpose: Display a Mission-owned jump-range overlay.
tools.inputSchema: missionId: string; originSystemId: number; effectiveRangeLy: number; label?: string
tools.sideEffects: Adds a temporary jump-range overlay.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, overlayId, origin, range, and reachable-system count.
tools.whenToUse: When the user explicitly asks to display an effective jump range.

tools.name: remove_jump_range
tools.purpose: Remove one Mission-owned jump range by opaque ID.
tools.sideEffects: Removes exactly one temporary overlay.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: For an explicit request to remove one known Mission range.
preconditions: Target Mission inspected when overlayId is not already known.

tools.name: clear_mission_jump_ranges
tools.purpose: Clear every jump range in one Mission.
tools.sideEffects: Removes all overlays in the specified Mission only.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to clear all ranges in one Mission.

tools.name: add_mission_marker
tools.purpose: Add a temporary Mission marker to one system.
tools.inputSchema: missionId: string; systemId: number; role: RALLY|DESTINATION|DANGER|BACKUP|WAYPOINT|INFO; label?: string; notes?: string; colorOverride?: RED|ORANGE|YELLOW|GREEN|BLUE|PURPLE|WHITE
tools.sideEffects: Adds a session-only marker.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, markerId, systemId, and role.
tools.whenToUse: For ordinary marker requests without explicit permanent-storage intent.

tools.name: remove_mission_marker
tools.purpose: Remove one Mission-owned marker by opaque ID.
tools.sideEffects: Removes exactly one temporary Mission marker; never a Saved Marker.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: For an explicit request to remove one known Mission marker.
preconditions: Target Mission inspected when markerId is not already known.

tools.name: clear_mission_markers
tools.purpose: Clear every marker in one Mission.
tools.sideEffects: Removes all temporary markers in the specified Mission only.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to clear all markers in one Mission.

tools.name: fit_mission
tools.purpose: Fit the viewport to one Mission's visual bounds.
tools.sideEffects: Changes shared map viewport framing.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks to fit or show the whole Mission.

tools.name: clear_mission
tools.purpose: Remove one entire temporary Mission.
tools.sideEffects: Removes the specified Mission and all its AI-owned visuals only.
tools.expectedResult: missionId confirmation.
tools.whenToUse: Only for an explicit whole-Mission removal request.

tools.name: create_saved_marker
tools.purpose: Create one persistent Saved Marker with optional initial tags.
tools.inputSchema: systemId: number; color: RED|ORANGE|YELLOW|GREEN|BLUE|PURPLE|WHITE; name?: string; notes?: string; tags?: [STAGING|RALLY|DANGER|LOGISTICS|HOME|BACKUP|INDUSTRIAL|STRATEGIC|KEEPSTAR]
tools.sideEffects: Creates one persistent marker; create-only and never overwrites existing state.
tools.expectedResult: Created marker.
tools.whenToUse: Only after explicit permanent-storage or Saved Marker intent.

tools.name: send_mission_navigation_to_eve
tools.purpose: Replace one explicitly selected connected EVE character's navigation with one identified Mission-owned Normal route's exact authored targets.
tools.inputSchema: missionId: string; routeId: string; characterId: string
tools.sideEffects: External destructive mutation: replaces the selected character's existing EVE navigation; may partially apply before a failure.
tools.expectedResult: missionId, routeId, characterId, exact targetSystemIds, status, and safe message; failures may report partial progress or ambiguity.
tools.whenToUse: Exactly once only after the user explicitly asks to send one unambiguously identified Mission Normal route to a specifically identified connected character.
preconditions: Exact Mission-owned Normal route resolved with missionId and routeId.
Explicit available characterId resolved with list_eve_navigation_targets.
Not a manual draft or Capital route.
commonSequence: report exact confirmed outcome without blind ambiguous retry
